Clause-②: no (prose-only describe edits, accept/reject unchanged) — but the same strings feed customer docs via `build-docs.ts`, so the PR must carry the full regen set and the gate families the card names. Hard serial: #11052 is in flight (`pm:dispatched`) on the same generated artifacts — this card dispatches only after its PR lands.

File-surface addendum to the R6 claim above (session `session_01NDGG54XF5gbTLdQzCtnaVV`), filed as the claim is extended rather than after the fact.

The dispatched surface named `packages/spec/src/{conversions,data,ui,automation,ai,api}`. That directory list was derived from the filing's source attribution, and reverse-looking-up each of the 14 generated sites to its real source line disproves part of it. Two of the six real sources sit outside the named directories:

- `packages/spec/src/shared/retry-policy.zod.ts` — the `#4661` in `objectstack-automation/references/_index.md`
- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` — the `#4001` in `objectstack-i18n/references/_index.md`

(The other four are in-surface: `data/driver/common.zod.ts`, `data/driver/config-registry.zod.ts`, `data/driver/turso.zod.ts`, `ui/react-blocks.ts`.)

Both are taken in place, and the claimed file surface is amended to include them. Same defect class as the card, mechanical rewrite whose correct form is pinned by the 2026-08-23 ruling, same gate families, no new verification surface, and no other in-flight claim holds either file — checked against the open-PR list. Stopping on the two would have delivered a card that closes 12 of its own 14 sites because a guess named the wrong directory.

Also now in the diff, from the same source edit reaching the docs site via `build-docs.ts`: `content/docs/references/data/driver-common.mdx` and `driver-turso.mdx`. The full regen set was called for at dispatch; naming the two files it actually moved.

Not touched, and flagged for routing rather than taken: `scripts/check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs` carries a `why` string for `check-doc-authoring.mjs` that names `GENERATED_SKILL_ARTIFACTS`, the constant this PR removes. The gate itself stays green (its verdict rests on the other declarations, and it was run), but the prose now names a symbol that no longer exists. PR #12061 is in flight on exactly that file and is itself marked blocked on a recorded verdict, so the one-clause repair should ride whichever of the two lands second rather than be raced here.
